# Masters India

> > Masters India is a GST Suvidha Provider offering compliance software, verification APIs, and tax management tools for Indian businesses.

Masters India provides comprehensive GST compliance solutions including GSTIN verification APIs, notice management software, return filing services, and free tax tools. The platform serves businesses with automated compliance tracking for GST, Income Tax, TDS, MCA, and E-Way Bill requirements across India.

## Key Topics

- GST Compliance
- GSTIN Verification
- GST API
- Tax Compliance
- E-Way Bill
- E-Invoice
- HSN Code
- MCA Company Search
- Notice Management
- Vendor Verification
- PAN Verification
- GST Return Filing
- India Taxation
- OCR Technology
- IFSC Code

## GST Verification & Search Tools

- [GST Verification API to Search Bulk GST Number Verification in a Click](https://www.mastersindia.co/gst-number-verification-api-bulk-utility): GST verification API for bulk GSTIN validation with ERP integration
- [GST Verification Search Tool - Check GST Number Online](https://www.mastersindia.co/gst-number-search-and-gstin-verification): Free online GST number verification and taxpayer details search tool
- [GST Search by PAN & Name | Know Your GST Number Online](https://www.mastersindia.co/gst-number-search-by-name-and-pan): Search and verify GST numbers using PAN and business name online
- [Check GST Return Status | GST Filing Status by GST Number](https://www.mastersindia.co/check-gst-return-status): Free tool to check GST return filing status by GSTIN or ARN number
- [Vendor APIs To Make Vendor Verification Easy](https://www.mastersindia.co/vendor-verification-api): Vendor verification APIs for GSTIN, MCA status, and GST return tracking

## Compliance Management Software

- [Masters India Notice Management Software - Automated Compliance & Legal Notice Tracking](https://www.mastersindia.co/notice-management-software): Notice management software for GST, Income Tax, and TDS compliance tracking
- [Contact Us | Masters India](https://www.mastersindia.co/gst-return-filing-services): Contact form for GST Suvidha Provider offering compliance solutions & APIs

## Tax Calculators & Reference Tools

- [Masters India Online GST Calculator 2024](https://www.mastersindia.co/gst-calculator): Free online GST calculator for goods and services tax computation
- [HSN Code Search List & GST Rate Finder 2024](https://www.mastersindia.co/hsn-code): HSN/SAC code search with GST rates for goods and services in India
- [MCA Company Search to Check Company Name Online Free](https://www.mastersindia.co/mca-company-detail): Free MCA database search for company name verification and master data
- [Search IFSC Code | Find Bank IFSC Code in India](https://www.mastersindia.co/ifsc-code): Search and verify IFSC codes for Indian bank branches for NEFT/RTGS/ECS

## GST Filing Guides & Documentation

- [GST Reports: A Comprehensive Guide to GSTR 1, GSTR 2, GSTR 3B, and GSTR 6](https://www.mastersindia.co/gst-reports-download): Comprehensive guide to GST reports including GSTR-1, 2, 3B, and 6 filing
- [GST Payment Online: How to Pay GST Challan?](https://www.mastersindia.co/gst-payment): Guide to online GST payment, challan generation, and payment modes
- [Revolutionizing Tax Compliance: The QRMP Advantage for Small Businesses](https://www.mastersindia.co/gst-filing-preference): Guide to QRMP quarterly return filing scheme for small businesses
